content:
alex: Security advisory - found GitHub deploy keys and a few personal access tokens accidentally checked into a private repo snapshot uploaded to a third-party support bucket. No public evidence of abuse yet, but treat as sensitive. Immediate actions: rotate affected tokens/keys, invalidate any CI secrets that use them, and rotate deploy keys. Target revoke window: 2026-04-06 18:00 UTC.

sec-bot: Scan details in RW-Sec-999. Affected items: 3 repo deploy keys (infra/deploy-key-prod, releases/publish-key, tools/legacy-deploy), 2 personal access tokens embedded in scripts. Full list sent to security owners via secure channel.

ci-team: Ack. Which CI systems are using the keys? We need exact names to rotate secrets in CircleCI/GitHub Actions and update secret manager entries.

alex: Short summary: GitHub Actions secrets: GH_ACTIONS_DEPLOY, NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN. CircleCI projects: infra-deploy and web-releases. Also an internal Jenkins job using legacy deploy key.

monica: I'll take GitHub Actions and npm token. I'll cut a new token and update repo secrets; will coordinate a short deployment window to restart any runners.

jordan: I'll take CircleCI projects and Jenkins. Will rotate keys and re-run canaries.

oncall-bot: Temporary maintenance window registered: 2026-04-06 18:00-19:00 UTC (ci-oncall).

sec-bot: Rotation checklist (examples):
- Revoke token/key in GitHub or provider immediately after new secret is confirmed working.
- Update secret in Secrets Manager or GitHub Actions repo secrets.
- Trigger a pipeline canary and verify deploys succeed.

Commands/examples:
```
# revoke a GitHub deploy key (requires repo admin)
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: token $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://api.github.com/repos/redwood/infra/keys/<key_id>"
# update GH Actions secret (example using gh CLI)
echo -n "$NEW_SECRET" | gh secret set GH_ACTIONS_DEPLOY --repo redwood/infra
```

alex: Owners should post a short status line after swap: `owner: service - secret: name - action: rotated/revoked - canary: success/fail - notes`

monica: owner: infra/ci - secret: NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN - action: rotated - canary: success - notes: package publish dry-run OK.

jordan: owner: web-releases - secret: GH_ACTIONS_DEPLOY - action: rotated - canary: fail - notes: a runner cache expected old SSH key, fixed by clearing runner cache, retried and success now.

ci-team: owner: jenkins-legacy - secret: legacy-deploy-key - action: revoked - canary: success - notes: replaced with short-lived key via our deployment service.

sec-bot: Post-rotation tasks: add detection rule to scan incoming uploads for private keys/tokens, enable repo secret scanning (if not already), and require PR approval for changes to secrets.

alex: Follow-up: we'll open RW-Sec-999 follow-up to track removing any checked-in creds across history and adding preventative CI lint hook. Thanks for fast work. If you touched any other creds during the fix, post here so we can track all rotations. :lock:
